children: Solana Company said Hong Kong’s Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises (OASES) has recognized it as a strategic enterprise and included it in the government’s seventh strategic enterprises list. According to Odaily, it is the only blockchain infrastructure company brought in by OASES in 2026. Solana Company has established an office in Hong Kong to serve as its Asia-Pacific headquarters and regional operations base, with its management team overseeing business in the region. The company plans to operate validator nodes in Hong Kong through its Pacific Backbone program.

title: Solana Company Named to Hong Kong’s Seventh Strategic Enterprises List as Its Only Blockchain Infrastructure Firm in 2026
